tagline: A breezy, upscale Asian side waterfront — beach clubs, Bağdat Avenue, and a relaxed affluent local scene.

items.name: Suadiye Sahil Cafés
items.description: Waterfront cafés along the Suadiye coast with Marmara views. Popular with the local professional crowd on weekday mornings.

items.name: Bağdat Caddesi Restoranları
items.description: Suadiye's stretch of Bağdat Avenue has excellent independent restaurants — slightly less crowded than the Caddebostan section.

items.name: Sahil Balık Restoranları
items.description: Waterfront fish restaurants with sea views and fresh Marmara catch. Good quality at honest prices.

items.name: Suadiye Plajı
items.description: A pleasant public beach popular with local families and young Istanbulites in summer. Clean and well-maintained.
items.tip: Weekday mornings are much more relaxed. Summer weekends get busy from about 11am onwards.

items.name: Bağdat Caddesi Walk
items.description: Istanbul's grand Asian side boulevard — tree-lined, bustling with cafés and boutiques. Walk the Suadiye section for a more residential feel than Caddebostan.

tips: Suadiye is on the metro (M4 line, Bostancı stop nearby) and easily reached from Kadıköy by bus or dolmuş.
More upscale and residential than neighbouring Caddebostan. Quieter and less touristy.
Bağdat Caddesi runs the full length — it's best explored on foot or by bicycle.
The waterfront promenade connects Fenerbahçe, Caddebostan, Suadiye, and Bostancı in one long walk.
